# Formground

> Formground helps people discover furniture, lighting and objects from makers. It indexes 28,177 products from 205 makers and links every result straight to the maker's own site. It sells nothing and shows no paid results in search.

Generated 2026-10-09; the catalog is re-scraped weekly. Prices and availability belong to the makers - always send people to the maker's own page (the `url` field), not to Formground.

## Search (machine-readable)

- [Agent search API](https://formground-git-182928637479.europe-west1.run.app/agent/search?q=round+dining+table): GET, no authentication. Natural-language query in `q` (product type, material, colour, maker country, seat count are understood). Returns schema.org Product-shaped JSON, balanced across makers so no single brand dominates.
- [OpenAPI description](https://formground.com/openapi.json): the exact request and response schema.

## Reading the price fields

- `priceStatus` is always present: `listed` (price and currency both known, see `offers`), `on_request` (the maker prices on application or to commission - send an enquiry), `dealer_priced` (the maker sets no public price; stockists do), or `unknown` (no data, no claim).
- A missing price is often correct, not an error: many makers do not publish prices. Do not estimate one.
- `offers.price` is exactly what the maker lists, in the maker's own currency (`offers.priceCurrency`, ISO 4217). Nothing is converted. Compare across currencies yourself if you need to.

## Browse the full catalog by type (static pages under /work/, every match listed)

- [Work](https://formground.com/work.html): search and the browse menu. 44 product types in three categories, each type listed in full and paginated, with schema.org Product data on every page.
- [Houses](https://formground.com/work/houses.html): every architect-designed house in the catalog, with country pages (e.g. https://formground.com/work/houses-sweden.html), each house linking to the architect's own project page
- [Furniture](https://formground.com/work/furniture.html): [Sofas](https://formground.com/work/sofas.html), [Chairs](https://formground.com/work/chairs.html), [Garden and Outdoor Chairs](https://formground.com/work/garden-chairs.html), [Side Chairs](https://formground.com/work/side-chairs.html), [Folding and Stacking Chairs](https://formground.com/work/folding-chairs.html), [Kids' Chairs](https://formground.com/work/kids-chairs.html), [Office and Desk Chairs](https://formground.com/work/office-chairs.html), [Dining Chairs](https://formground.com/work/dining-chairs.html), [Armchairs and Lounge Chairs](https://formground.com/work/armchairs.html), [Stools](https://formground.com/work/stools.html), [Bar Stools](https://formground.com/work/bar-stools.html), [Benches](https://formground.com/work/benches.html), [Footstools](https://formground.com/work/footstools.html), [Ottomans and Poufs](https://formground.com/work/ottomans-and-poufs.html), [Dining Tables](https://formground.com/work/dining-tables.html), [Coffee Tables](https://formground.com/work/coffee-tables.html), [Side Tables](https://formground.com/work/side-tables.html), [Console Tables](https://formground.com/work/console-tables.html), [Bedside Tables](https://formground.com/work/bedside-tables.html), [Outdoor Tables](https://formground.com/work/outdoor-tables.html), [Bar Tables](https://formground.com/work/bar-tables.html), [Desks](https://formground.com/work/desks.html), [Sideboards](https://formground.com/work/sideboards.html), [Cabinets](https://formground.com/work/cabinets.html), [Shelving](https://formground.com/work/shelving.html), [Beds](https://formground.com/work/beds.html), [Mirrors](https://formground.com/work/mirrors.html)
- [Lighting](https://formground.com/work/lighting.html): [Table Lamps](https://formground.com/work/table-lamps.html), [Pendant Lamps](https://formground.com/work/pendant-lamps.html), [Wall Lamps](https://formground.com/work/wall-lamps.html), [Ceiling Lamps](https://formground.com/work/ceiling-lamps.html), [Chandeliers](https://formground.com/work/chandeliers.html), [Floor Lamps](https://formground.com/work/floor-lamps.html), [Portable Lamps](https://formground.com/work/portable-lamps.html)
- [Objects](https://formground.com/work/objects.html): [Candle Holders](https://formground.com/work/candle-holders.html), [Candles](https://formground.com/work/candles.html), [Glass](https://formground.com/work/glass.html), [Vases](https://formground.com/work/vases.html), [Bowls](https://formground.com/work/bowls.html), [Plates](https://formground.com/work/plates.html), [Trays](https://formground.com/work/trays.html), [Rugs](https://formground.com/work/rugs.html), [Cushions](https://formground.com/work/cushions.html), [Blankets and Throws](https://formground.com/work/blankets.html)

## Curated and reference pages

- [Edits](https://formground.com/edits.html): hand-picked selections by theme.
- [Makers](https://formground.com/makers.html): every maker, one page each at https://formground.com/brands/{maker-slug}.html listing their full range.
- [Designers](https://formground.com/designers.html): independent product designers and their pieces.
- [New](https://formground.com/work/new.html): pieces new from their makers in the last 90 days, by category.
- [Sitemap](https://formground.com/sitemap.xml)

## Notes

- Categories are normalized by Formground and are not always the maker's own wording; footstools, ottomans/poufs and stools are separate types, as are candle holders and candles.
- `tier` is hand-curated: `established` marks a well-known or multinational design house, everything else is `independent`.
- Please keep request volume modest. Questions or corrections: [contact](https://formground.com/contact.html).
